question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Sell like hot cakes
solution:
The correct answer is: **Quick sell out.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom '**Sell like hot cakes'** means something that is sold very quickly or in large numbers.**(जल्दी/अधिक मात्रा में बिकना )**
 
• **Example:- **The new game is apparently selling like hot cakes.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Quick sell out**.
